_meta.description: Test payloads for the Texas Home Services Lead Recovery Engine n8n MVP — V4.3 security/configuration patch (01-lead-intake-v4.3). T01–T20 are the preserved V4.2 regression cases; B01–B07 and E01–E04 are the new V4.3 booking-URL and owner-email tests.
_meta.booking_note: B01–B05/B06–B07 exercise the V4.3 HTTPS-only booking-URL validation. B03/B04/B05 use biz_hillcountry_plumbing (which has an EMPTY config booking_link) so an invalid request link resolves to 'absent'. B06/B07 use biz_lonestar_hvac (which HAS a config booking_link) to verify the trusted-config fallback.
_meta.owner_email_note: E01–E04 exercise the V4.3 owner-email gate (owner_email AND from_email). E01 uses biz_lonestar_hvac (both present). E02–E04 require business_config rows with the specified email fields blank; create those rows (active=TRUE) before running.
_meta.note: Each test lists the target workflow, HTTP method, required headers, JSON body, and expected behavior across: workflow_path, http_response, lead_sheet_result, follow_up_result, email_behavior, error_behavior.
_meta.headers_note: Set X-Lead-Engine-Secret to the value configured as the LEAD_ENGINE_SECRET environment variable on the n8n instance.
_meta.concurrency_note: Google Sheets duplicate detection is retry-aware but NOT transactionally race-safe under concurrent requests (T07 documents this limitation).
_meta.tenant_scope_note: All duplicate comparisons (idempotency_key, source_id, phone, email) are scoped by business_id. T03 and T05 verify that identical keys/source IDs across DIFFERENT businesses are NOT treated as duplicates.

body.name: John Carter
body.message: I need an AC quote for my 3,000 sq ft home in Austin.

expected.workflow_path: Webhook -> secret -> business_id -> config -> normalize -> business valid -> existing leads -> duplicate check -> NOT duplicate -> Append Lead -> Compute Next Follow-up -> Update Lead Next Follow-up -> Respond 200 Created; then fan-out to Prepare Email Content -> customer + owner email branches
expected.follow_up_result: next_followup_at persisted on that row (now + followup_delay_hours).
expected.email_behavior: Customer acknowledgment + owner notification both attempted (independent branches).

body.name: Ana Ruiz
body.message: Retry with same idempotency key, same business.

expected.workflow_path: Send T02 twice with the SAME idempotency_key and SAME business_id. Second call -> idempotency_key + business_id match -> Is Duplicate? TRUE -> Respond 200 Duplicate Accepted
expected.http_response: First: 200 created. Second: 200 { status: 'accepted', duplicate: true, reason: 'idempotency_key', lead_id, code: 200 }
expected.lead_sheet_result: Exactly ONE lead row across both calls.
expected.email_behavior: Emails sent only on the first call.

tests.name: Duplicate idempotency key — DIFFERENT business (tenant scope)

body.name: Bob Rivera
body.message: Same idempotency key but a DIFFERENT business. Must NOT be a duplicate.

expected.workflow_path: idempotency_key matches an existing row, but business_id differs -> NOT a duplicate -> Append Lead -> ... -> Respond 200 Created
expected.lead_sheet_result: A NEW lead row is created for biz_hillcountry_plumbing (tenant isolation preserved).
expected.follow_up_result: next_followup_at persisted on the new row.
expected.email_behavior: Emails attempted for the new lead.

body.name: John Carter
body.message: Same upstream source_id re-delivered, same business.

expected.workflow_path: source_id + source_type + business_id match T01 -> duplicate (source_id)
expected.email_behavior: No new emails.

tests.name: Source ID same value — DIFFERENT business (tenant scope)

body.name: Carla Nguyen
body.message: Same source_id as T01 but different business. Must NOT be a duplicate.

expected.workflow_path: source_id matches, but business_id differs -> NOT a duplicate -> Append Lead -> Respond 200 Created
expected.lead_sheet_result: A NEW lead row created for biz_hillcountry_plumbing.
expected.email_behavior: Emails attempted.

body.name: Johnny Carter
body.message: Same phone digits, new source id.

expected.workflow_path: phone digits match T01 phone after normalization + same business_id -> duplicate (phone)
expected.email_behavior: No new emails.

body.name: Concurrent User
body.message: Fired twice nearly simultaneously.

expected.workflow_path: Two identical requests sent at the same time can BOTH pass the read-then-append duplicate check before either sees the other's row.
expected.http_response: Both may return 200 created (or one duplicate, depending on timing).
expected.lead_sheet_result: TWO rows may be created. KNOWN concurrency limitation — retry-aware but not transactionally race-safe.
expected.email_behavior: Emails may be sent twice.
expected.error_behavior: None; documented limitation, not a failure. Production fix = unique index on idempotency_key.

body.name: J. Carter
body.message: Same normalized email, new phone.

expected.workflow_path: email lowercased+trimmed matches T01 email + same business_id -> duplicate (email)
expected.email_behavior: No new emails.

expected.workflow_path: Valid Ingress Secret? FALSE -> Respond 401 (before any Sheets access)
expected.email_behavior: None.

body.name: No Biz
body.message: no business id

expected.workflow_path: Business ID Present? FALSE -> Respond 400 Missing business_id
expected.email_behavior: None.

body.name: Ghost
body.message: no such business

expected.workflow_path: config not found -> Business Valid & Active? FALSE -> Respond 403
expected.email_behavior: None.

body.name: Closed Biz
body.message: business inactive

expected.workflow_path: config found but active=false -> Business Valid & Active? FALSE -> Respond 403
expected.email_behavior: None.

body.name: Rita Sosa
body.message: Furnace not igniting.

expected.workflow_path: no email -> Customer Email Present? FALSE -> Skip Customer Email; Owner branch still runs; lead persists + responds
expected.email_behavior: Customer email SKIPPED; owner notification attempted.

body.name: No Owner
body.message: Plumbing config has no owner_email.

expected.workflow_path: Owner Email Present? FALSE -> Skip Owner Email; lead persists + responds
expected.email_behavior: Owner notification SKIPPED; customer acknowledgment attempted.

body.name: Email Fail Customer
body.message: Customer email will fail / SMTP errors.

expected.workflow_path: Customer Acknowledgment errors -> onError continueErrorOutput -> Build Customer Email Error Record -> Append Customer Email Error. Owner branch independent. Response already sent.
expected.http_response: 200 created (email failure does NOT change response)
expected.email_behavior: Customer email FAILS and is logged; owner notification still attempted.
expected.error_behavior: SMTP error sanitized + logged to `errors` (node=Customer Acknowledgment); no leak to customer; no second lead.

body.name: Owner Fail Test
body.message: Owner recipient invalid -> SMTP errors.

expected.workflow_path: Owner Notification errors -> continueErrorOutput -> Build Owner Email Error Record -> Append Owner Email Error. Customer branch independent.
expected.http_response: 200 created (owner email failure does NOT change response)
expected.email_behavior: Owner email FAILS and is logged; customer acknowledgment still attempted.
expected.error_behavior: Owner email failure sanitized + logged; lead remains valid.

body.message: bold & tag

expected.workflow_path: Normalize stores raw values in the lead row but emits HTML-escaped _esc_* copies for the email templates.
expected.lead_sheet_result: Raw message/name stored unchanged in `leads` (plain storage).
expected.email_behavior: Emails render ESCAPED values (<script>, &, ") — no HTML/script executes.

body.name: Booking Link User
body.message: Business config has a booking_link.

expected.workflow_path: withLeadId() substitutes {{lead_id}} or appends ?lead_id=<id> when the config link lacks a lead identifier.
expected.lead_sheet_result: Lead stored with booking_link containing its own lead_id.
expected.email_behavior: Customer email includes the booking link; owner email lists it.

expected.workflow_path: No name/email/phone/message. Normalize builds a minimal lead (empty optional fields), deterministic hash key from available fields -> persists.
expected.http_response: 200 created (score computed from available fields, likely low)
expected.email_behavior: Customer email skipped (no email); owner notification attempted.

body.name: Sheets Down
body.message: Revoke sheets access / rename leads tab to force failure.

expected.workflow_path: Append Lead fails -> workflow errors (error workflow 06 captures). No 200 created.
expected.http_response: No 200 created (system does NOT falsely report success).
expected.email_behavior: Emails NOT attempted (branch only after persistence).
expected.error_behavior: Critical failure surfaced to error workflow, not swallowed.

tests.name: Booking link — valid HTTPS accepted with lead_id attribution

body.name: Book Link HTTPS
body.message: Valid HTTPS booking link supplied in the request.

expected.workflow_path: Normalize -> safeBookingLink accepts the https:// URL and appends ?lead_id=<id> (attribution). Lead persists and responds 200.
expected.email_behavior: Customer email includes the HTTPS booking link; owner email lists it. No unsafe scheme.

tests.name: Booking link — existing lead_id preserved (no duplicate param)

body.name: Book Link Existing ID
body.message: HTTPS booking link that already carries a lead_id query param.

expected.workflow_path: safeBookingLink preserves the existing lead_id and does NOT append a second one.
expected.email_behavior: Booking link rendered with the existing lead_id only.

tests.name: Booking link — javascript: blocked (treated as absent)

body.name: Malicious JS Link
body.message: javascript: scheme must never become a clickable href.

expected.workflow_path: safeBookingLink rejects javascript: (protocol !== https:). Config booking_link is empty for this business, so booking_link resolves to absent. Lead persists and responds 200.
expected.lead_sheet_result: Lead stored with EMPTY booking_link (no javascript: value stored).
expected.email_behavior: No booking href rendered in either email. Emails are safe.
expected.error_behavior: None. Lead is valid despite the malicious booking_link.

tests.name: Booking link — data: blocked (treated as absent)

body.name: Malicious Data Link
body.message: data: scheme must never become a clickable href.

expected.workflow_path: safeBookingLink rejects data: (protocol !== https:). booking_link resolves to absent. Lead persists and responds 200.
expected.email_behavior: No booking href rendered.

tests.name: Booking link — malformed URL handled safely (treated as absent)

body.name: Malformed Link
body.message: Malformed URL must be treated as absent, not thrown.

expected.workflow_path: new URL(...) throws -> safeBookingLink returns ''. booking_link resolves to absent. No unhandled exception. Lead persists and responds 200.
expected.email_behavior: No booking href rendered.
expected.error_behavior: None. No unhandled exception from the malformed URL.

tests.name: Booking link — no request link, valid config link used with attribution

body.name: Config Link Fallback
body.message: No booking_link in the request; the business config link should be used.

expected.workflow_path: body.booking_link absent -> fall back to business_config.booking_link (https://book.lonestarhvac.example.com/?lead_id={{lead_id}}), {{lead_id}} substituted with the lead's id.
expected.email_behavior: Customer/owner emails include the config booking link with lead_id attribution.

tests.name: Booking link — invalid request link falls back to trusted config link

body.name: Invalid Request Link
body.message: Request supplies an invalid booking link; the trusted config link should be used instead.

expected.workflow_path: body.booking_link is invalid (javascript:) -> treated as absent -> fall back to the trusted business_config.booking_link (validated HTTPS).
expected.lead_sheet_result: Lead stored with the CONFIG booking link (https://book.lonestarhvac.example.com/?lead_id=<lead_id>), NOT the javascript: value.
expected.email_behavior: Emails include the trusted config booking link; no unsafe href.

tests.name: Owner email — owner_email + from_email present -> send

body.name: Owner Gate E01
body.message: Business has both owner_email and from_email configured.

expected.workflow_path: Owner Email Present? TRUE (owner_email isNotEmpty AND _fromEmailPresent) -> Owner Notification sends.
expected.email_behavior: Owner notification attempted (owner_email + from_email present).

tests.name: Owner email — owner_email present + from_email missing -> skip (no SMTP, no error)

body.name: Owner Gate E02
body.message: Requires a business_config row with owner_email set and from_email BLANK (active=TRUE).

expected.workflow_path: Owner Email Present? FALSE (_fromEmailPresent false despite owner_email) -> Skip Owner Email. No SMTP attempt.
expected.email_behavior: Owner notification SKIPPED cleanly. No SMTP delivery attempted and NO email-failure error generated.
expected.error_behavior: None (missing from_email is configuration, not an SMTP failure).

tests.name: Owner email — owner_email missing + from_email present -> skip (no SMTP, no error)

body.name: Owner Gate E03
body.message: Requires a business_config row with owner_email BLANK and from_email set (active=TRUE).

expected.workflow_path: Owner Email Present? FALSE (owner_email empty) -> Skip Owner Email. No SMTP attempt.
expected.email_behavior: Owner notification SKIPPED cleanly. No SMTP delivery attempted and NO email-failure error generated.

tests.name: Owner email — owner_email + from_email both missing -> skip (no SMTP, no error)

body.name: Owner Gate E04
body.message: Requires a business_config row with BOTH owner_email and from_email BLANK (active=TRUE).

expected.workflow_path: Owner Email Present? FALSE (both empty) -> Skip Owner Email. No SMTP attempt.
expected.email_behavior: Owner notification SKIPPED cleanly. No SMTP delivery attempted and NO email-failure error generated.
